search.title: Search
search.description: Searches every page and message you may read. Arrow keys choose, Enter opens.
search.hint: Type a term to find pages, messages and tickets.

home.title: Pages in this space
home.empty: This space has no pages yet.
home.emptyCreate: This space has no pages yet. Create the first one.

create.title: New page
create.description: The page starts as a draft; once published, every reader of the space sees it.

page.empty: This page has no content yet.
page.notFound: This page does not exist (any more).

links.missing: This page does not exist yet.

conflict.reloaded: Someone changed the page in the meantime. The current version is loaded – check it and try again.

move.title: Move page
move.description: Where should “{{title}}” go? Subpages move along.

tags.title: Page tags
tags.description: Tags apply to the whole organisation or only to this space.

editor.title: Edit page
editor.hint: Save with Ctrl+S. Links to other pages: [[Title]].
editor.leaveConfirm: Your changes are not saved. Leave anyway?
editor.conflictTitle: The page was changed in the meantime
editor.conflictText: Someone saved the page while you were editing it. Keep your version to put it on top of the current one and save again; discard it to see the current version.
editor.rebased: The current version is loaded; your text is kept. Saving overwrites the other person's change.

versions.title: Versions of “{{title}}”
versions.caption: Versions of the page, newest first
versions.pickTwo: Choose two different versions to compare them.
versions.restoreText: The content of version {{number}} is saved as a new version. A live editing session on the page ends.
versions.label: Name
versions.labelHint: Leave empty to remove the name.

trash.title: Trash
trash.description: Pages in the trash are hidden from everyone until they are restored.
trash.purgeText: “{{title}}” is deleted with all subpages, versions and attachments. This cannot be undone.
trash.confirmText: “{{title}}” and all its subpages go to the trash. Moderators can restore them.

attachments.title: Attachments
attachments.deleteText: “{{name}}” is deleted. Links to it stop working.

transfer.importDescription: A ZIP of Markdown files (folders become subpages, attachments under _attachments/). Existing pages stay unchanged.

reasons.type_mismatch: extension does not match the content

live.label: Content of “{{title}}”
live.alone: Nobody else is here right now.
live.hint: Changes are saved automatically (within 10 seconds at most) and appear for everyone editing the page right now.
live.notSaved: Your latest changes are not saved yet. Please try again in a moment.

unsaveable.markdown: The current state cannot be saved as Markdown like this: as Markdown it would read differently from what is shown here.

example.tableCode: The cause is code with a backslash in a table cell: a backslash right before | cannot be written as Markdown there.
example.address: The cause is an address or e-mail address the page would link differently from how it stands here (for example two e-mail addresses joined by +).
example.list: The cause is a list Markdown would read as something else (for example empty nested items read as a rule).

unsaveable.reopen: The current state cannot be saved as Markdown like this: the live editor could not open the Markdown again unchanged.
unsaveable.structure: The current state cannot be saved as Markdown like this: its structure is not valid for the editor.
unsaveable.unknown: The current state cannot be saved as Markdown like this.
unsaveable.timeout: The current state was not saved: checking it took too long. The page is too heavy for live editing; edit it in the Markdown editor.
unsaveable.tooLarge: The current state is too large for live editing: the page's tables hold more than {{cells}} table cells in all. Take rows out, or edit the page in the Markdown editor.
unsaveable.wherePair: It concerns blocks {{number}} and {{next}}, which cannot be saved together (“{{start}}” …).
unsaveable.wherePairEmpty: It concerns blocks {{number}} and {{next}}, which cannot be saved together.
unsaveable.rest: The latest changes stay unsaved until it is changed; the session goes on.

leaveConfirm.unconfirmed: The server has not yet confirmed that your latest changes are saved. Leave anyway? They may be lost.
leaveConfirm.unsent: Your latest changes have not reached the server yet (the connection is interrupted). Leave anyway? They will be lost.
leaveConfirm.unsaveable: The current state cannot be saved (see the notice). Leave anyway? The changes since the last save will be lost.
leaveConfirm.lost: Your text is not saved. Copy it as Markdown first. Leave anyway?

live.regenerated: The page was changed outside the live session (saved, restored or moved). The current version is loaded.

stop.unauthorized: Your session has expired. Please log in again.
stop.forbidden: You may not edit this page. The text is read-only.
stop.not_found: This page is no longer visible (moved, deleted or rights changed).
stop.too_large: The page is too large or too heavy for live editing (at most {{cells}} table cells and 200,000 characters, and checking it must not take too long). Edit it in the Markdown editor.
stop.off: Live editing is turned off on this server.
stop.connection_limit: You have too many live connections open (at most 3 per page and 10 in all per sign-in). Close other windows with this page and reload.
stop.not_roundtrip_safe: This page contains Markdown that the live editor cannot edit without changing it. To keep its meaning intact, edit it in the Markdown editor.
stop.invalid_content: The live editor cannot show the shared state of this page. So that nothing is lost, the session was ended without saving anything. Edit the page in the Markdown editor.
stop.server_error: The live connection to this page keeps failing with a server error while loading. Edit the page in the Markdown editor or try again later.
stop.busy: The live editor is busy right now: many large pages are open live already. Try again shortly (Reload), or edit the page in the Markdown editor.

errors.unsupportedType: This kind of file is not accepted.

request.too_large: That is too large for one request.

page.not_found: This page does not exist (any more).
page.version_conflict: Someone changed the page in the meantime.
page.parent_draft: The parent page is still a draft. Publish it first.
page.parent_not_found: The parent page does not exist (any more).
page.too_deep: Pages cannot be nested this deeply.
page.move_other_space: Pages cannot move to another space.
page.move_cycle: A page cannot move below itself or its subpages.
page.path_taken: There already is a page of this name there.
page.not_trashed: The page is not in the trash.
page.diff_too_large: The versions are too long to compare.

tags.name_taken: A tag of this name exists already.
tags.version_conflict: Someone changed this tag in the meantime.
tags.wrong_space: This tag belongs to another space.

attachment.not_found: This attachment does not exist (any more).
attachment.type_not_allowed: This kind of file is not allowed as an attachment.
attachment.type_mismatch: The file extension does not match the file's content.

import.too_large: The archive is too large or holds too many files.
import.invalid_zip: This is not a valid ZIP file.
